## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Consistently cool, calm, and master of himself, this man exhibits an imperturbable confidence and unparalleled courage, remaining bold even to the point of rashness. He maintains a cold expression alongside a distinct aversion to islands and continents. Over time, he has grown graver, more taciturn, retired, and less sociable, while harboring a fierce and implacable defiance towards human society. His motivations include reaching the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), sinking an attacking warship, and using salvaged underwater treasures to console suffering beings and avenge oppressed races. Highly skilled and educated, he is multilingual in French, English, German, and Latin, and he demonstrates notable talent in playing the organ. Additionally, he possesses sharp deductive reasoning and observation skills, as well as an extraordinary ability as an agile climber capable of scaling steep slopes with ease.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P68](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P26](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P19](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P23](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0023), +14 more_

## History

Captain Nemo revealed his identity to Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), informing them that they were to remain prisoners aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) forever. He took [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on a tour of his submarine, showing off its extensive library, art collections, and advanced technology before guiding him on various undersea excursions, including a hunt in the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. Along their travels, Nemo displayed his mastery of the ocean, revealing papers from the lost expedition of La Pérouse at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro) and freeing the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) from a coral reef in the [Torres Straits](../codex/places.md#torres-straits) using an electric barrier to repel [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) islanders. He showed a deeply personal commitment to the oppressed, fighting off a shark to rescue an Indian pearl diver off [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon) and secretly funneling salvaged gold to a Greek diver off [Crete](../codex/places.md#crete). After navigating through a subterranean passage under the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean), he guided the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay), where his crew harvested treasure from sunken Spanish galleons. Nemo then journeyed across the ocean floor to show [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) the submerged ruins of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis), survived being trapped beneath [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) ice, and successfully claimed the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) under his own name. Following an attack by giant cuttlefish that claimed the life of a crewman, Nemo forcefully rejected Aronnax's plea for freedom and declared they would never leave the ship. Driven by a deep desire for vengeance, Nemo submerged the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to show [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) the wreck of 'Le Vengeur' before raising his black flag to ram and destroy an attacking warship. In the emotional aftermath of the attack, Nemo was overheard mournfully weeping in the saloon while playing the organ shortly before the vessel entered the deadly Norwegian maelstrom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P40](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P58](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P69](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0069), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P71](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P86](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0086), +76 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 1**

- constructed the Nautilus with his workmen on a desert island  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>
- destroyed all traces of his workshop with fire after finishing the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII SOME FIGURES P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>
- found the final wreck of La Perouse's expedition  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048)</sub>
- personally gathered every shell in his collection from the sea  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P101](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0101)</sub>
- purchased his final volumes before plunging underwater  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P75](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0075)</sub>
- severed all ties with society and its laws  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P18](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0018)</sub>
- used to greedily collect fine works of art  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P91](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0091)</sub>

**Volume 2**

- lost his country, wife, children, father, and mother to an oppressor nation  <sub>[v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P35](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0035)</sub>
- was present in the seas during the emergence of the island of Aphroessa  <sub>[v2 CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO P99](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0099)</sub>

## Quotes

> “Sir,” said Captain Nemo, “we will, if you please, take our bearings and fix the starting-point of this voyage. It is a quarter to twelve; I will go up again to the surface.”
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P4](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0004)

> “Well, Professor,” replied the Captain, “we shall show you better than that I hope. As to the mean depth of this part of the Pacific, I tell you it is only 4,000 yards.”
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)

> "Besides, M. Aronnax, the Nautilus is not lost; it will carry you yet into the midst of the marvels of the ocean. Our voyage is only begun, and I do not wish to be deprived so soon of the honour of your company."
>
> — Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024)

> "Well, the thing is easy. Though, if we see the fisheries, we shall not see the fishermen. The annual exportation has not yet begun. Never mind, I will give orders to make for the Gulf of Manaar, where we shall arrive in the night."
>
> — Nemo — [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)

> "I warn you, the way will be tiring. We shall have far to walk, and must climb a mountain. The roads are not well kept."
>
> — Nemo — [v2 CHAPTER IX A VANISHED CONTINENT P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022)
